facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2005-0113 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 12 October 2005 as a scheduled change under engineering change note; no event precedes it in the record. The engineering change note record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to restate an existing duty without altering what it requires. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the key safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-ELE-008.
